name: Trailer Launch
tagline: A product or mission goes in, a cinematic trailer with a silence-then-drop reveal comes out.
description: A 45–60 second launch trailer, the kind that feels like a documentary or sci-fi teaser: a mythology hook, rising stakes, a mandatory silence, a beat-drop reveal, real product hero shots, and a logo CTA. Voiceover and kinetic type carry the story; act 1 can look archival (CRT, grain, boxy frames) and the picture goes clean and wide after the drop. Not a 15-second curiosity sting, and not a SaaS UI walk-through.
bring: The product or mission name, one-line promise, and a CTA (URL, waitlist, or 'build with us')
Archival or epic B-roll, plus real product hero footage or renders
Your logo (alpha preferred). Optional: brand colors and font, licensed quote clips you own the rights to, a music track
get: A 45–60 s cinematic trailer with voiceover, kinetic type and a silence-then-drop (16:9, or 9:16 on request)

needs.name: Trailer music script and beat sheet
Hyperframes (or your project's video tool), Python 3 and ffmpeg
Music, if you want a real track
Stock or archival footage, if you don't already have B-roll

steps: Write the voiceover and lay it on the silence-then-drop arc
Collect archival, B-roll and real product hero footage
Score atmosphere, a rising build, a silence gap and the climax
Build the cut with kinetic type and act-1 degradation
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
